verdict.rationale: Mastra is a code-first TS framework runnable on Node.js/Bun/Deno/Cloudflare and deployable to any Node-compatible environment or self-hosted, and workflows support cron schedules and background tasks, implying it can run without any UI (Studio is a separate optional tool at localhost:4111). However there is no explicit CI/headless-mode documentation, CLI flag, or CI pipeline example demonstrating this directly. Missing for 10: explicit CI/automation docs or examples, dedicated headless-mode flag/CLI, independent hands-on confirmation of CI usage.
